Comprehensive evaluation on S5-HES Agent demonstrates that the RAG pipeline achieves near-optimal retrieval fidelity, simulated device behaviour and threat scenarios align with real-world IoT datasets, and simulation engine scales predictably across home configurations, establishing a stable foundation for Society 5.0 smart home research. Source code is available under the MIT License at https://github.com/AsiriweLab/S5-HES-Agent.

title: Piecewise linear interpolation via kernels
summary: We consider piecewise linear interpolation from the perspective of kernel interpolation and quadrature. If the Sobolev space $W_2^1(0, 1)$ is equipped with a suitable inner product, its reproducing kernel is piecewise linear and gives rise to piecewise linear interpolation. We show that such kernels are Green kernels for certain second-order partial differential equations and use kernel-based superconvergence theory to obtain rates of convergence for approximation of functions lying in $W_2^s(0, 1)$ for $s \in [1, 2]$. The rates coincide with classical rates for linear splines.

title: Hermes: A Unified High-Performance NTT Architecture with Hybrid Dataflow
summary: Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) relies heavily on the Number Theoretic Transform (NTT), making NTT a major performance bottleneck due to its intensive polynomial computations. Hybrid Homomorphic Encryption (HHE), which integrates arithmetic and logic FHE, further requires support for multiple NTT lengths. However, existing accelerators mainly optimize NTT throughput and do not provide unified support for HHE. This paper presents Hermes, a unified high-performance NTT architecture based on hybrid dataflow. Hermes exploits parallelism along both temporal and spatial dimensions and incorporates a fully pipelined on-chip computing core. A conflict-free on-chip fragmentation algorithm is introduced to resolve bank conflicts and enable burst HBM access, while an efficient dataflow improves computational intensity through data reuse, reducing bandwidth demand. Experimental results show that Hermes supports multiple NTT lengths and achieves up to 13.6x and 1.3x higher throughput than state-of-the-art GPU and FPGA accelerators, respectively. Our source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Hermes_conf-4E6F.

title: Benchmarking LLM Summaries of Multimodal Clinical Time Series for Remote Monitoring
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent clinical summaries of remote therapeutic monitoring time series. However, it remains unclear whether these narratives faithfully capture clinically significant events, such as sustained abnormalities. Existing evaluation metrics primarily focus on semantic similarity and linguistic quality, leaving event-level correctness largely unmeasured.
  To address this gap, we introduce an event-based evaluation framework for multimodal time-series summarization using the Technology-Integrated Health Management (TIHM)-1.5 dementia monitoring dataset. Clinically grounded daily events are derived through rule-based abnormal thresholds and temporal persistence criteria. Model-generated summaries are then aligned with these structured facts.
  Our evaluation protocol measures abnormality recall, duration recall, measurement coverage, and hallucinated event mentions. We benchmark three approaches: zero-shot prompting, statistical prompting, and a vision-based pipeline that uses rendered time-series visualizations. The results reveal a striking decoupling between conventional metrics and clinical event fidelity. Models that achieve high semantic similarity scores often exhibit near-zero abnormality recall. In contrast, the vision-based approach demonstrates the strongest event alignment, achieving 45.7% abnormality recall and 100% duration recall.
  These findings underscore the importance of event-aware evaluation to ensure reliable clinical time-series summarization.

title: TopoMaskV3: 3D Mask Head with Dense Offset and Height Predictions for Road Topology Understanding
summary: Mask-based paradigms for road topology understanding, such as TopoMaskV2, offer a complementary alternative to query-based methods by generating centerlines via a dense rasterized intermediate representation. However, prior work was limited to 2D predictions and suffered from severe discretization artifacts, necessitating fusion with parametric heads. We introduce TopoMaskV3, which advances this pipeline into a robust, standalone 3D predictor via two novel dense prediction heads: a dense offset field for sub-grid discretization correction within the existing BEV resolution, and a dense height map for direct 3D estimation. Beyond the architecture, we are the first to address geographic data leakage in road topology evaluation by introducing (1) geographically distinct splits to prevent memorization and ensure fair generalization, and (2) a long-range (+/-100 m) benchmark. TopoMaskV3 achieves state-of-the-art 28.5 OLS on this geographically disjoint benchmark, surpassing all prior methods. Our analysis shows that the mask representation is more robust to geographic overfitting than Bezier, while LiDAR fusion is most beneficial at long range and exhibits larger relative gains on the overlapping original split, suggesting overlap-induced memorization effects.

title: (hu)Man vs. Machine: In the Future of Motorsport, can Autonomous Vehicles Compete?
summary: Motorsport has historically driven technological innovation in the automotive industry. Autonomous racing provides a proving ground to push the limits of performance of autonomous vehicle (AV) systems. In principle, AVs could be at least as fast, if not faster, than humans. However, human driven racing provides broader audience appeal thus far, and is more strategically challenging. Both provide opportunities to push each other even further technologically, yet competitions remain separate. This paper evaluates whether the future of motorsport could encompass joint competition between humans and AVs. Analysis of the current state of the art, as well as recent competition outcomes, shows that while technical performance has reached comparable levels, there are substantial challenges in racecraft, strategy and safety that need to be overcome. Outstanding issues involved in mixed human-AI racing, ranging from an initial assessment of critical factors such as system-level latencies, to effective planning and risk guarantees are explored. The crucial non-technical aspect of audience engagement and appeal regarding the changing character of motorsport is addressed. In the wider context of motorsport and AVs, this work outlines a proposed agenda for future research to 'keep pushing the possible', in the true spirit of motorsport.

title: RubricBench: Aligning Model-Generated Rubrics with Human Standards
summary: As Large Language Model (LLM) alignment evolves from simple completions to complex, highly sophisticated generation, Reward Models are increasingly shifting toward rubric-guided evaluation to mitigate surface-level biases. However, the community lacks a unified benchmark to assess this evaluation paradigm, as existing benchmarks lack both the discriminative complexity and the ground-truth rubric annotations required for rigorous analysis. To bridge this gap, we introduce RubricBench, a curated benchmark with 1,147 pairwise comparisons specifically designed to assess the reliability of rubric-based evaluation. Our construction employs a multi-dimensional filtration pipeline to target hard samples featuring nuanced input complexity and misleading surface bias, augmenting each with expert-annotated, atomic rubrics derived strictly from instructions. Comprehensive experiments reveal a substantial capability gap between human-annotated and model-generated rubrics, indicating that even state-of-the-art models struggle to autonomously specify valid evaluation criteria, lagging considerably behind human-guided performance.

title: LFPO: Likelihood-Free Policy Optimization for Masked Diffusion Models
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has achieved remarkable success in improving autoregressive models, especially in domains requiring correctness like mathematical reasoning and code generation. However, directly applying such paradigms to Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) is fundamentally hindered by the intractability of exact likelihood computation, which forces existing methods to rely on high-variance approximations. To bridge this gap, we propose Likelihood-Free Policy Optimization (LFPO), a native framework that maps the concept of vector field flow matching to the discrete token space. Specifically, LFPO formulates alignment as geometric velocity rectification, which directly optimizes denoising logits via contrastive updates. This design effectively bypasses the errors inherent in likelihood approximation, yielding the precise gradient estimation. Furthermore, LFPO enforce consistency by predicting final solutions from intermediate steps, effectively straightening the probability flow to enable high-quality generation with significantly fewer iterations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LFPO not only outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on code and reasoning benchmarks but also accelerates inference by approximately 20% through reduced diffusion steps.

title: From Secure Agentic AI to Secure Agentic Web: Challenges, Threats, and Future Directions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agentic systems that plan, memorize, and act in open-world environments. This shift brings new security problems: failures are no longer only unsafe text generation, but can become real harm through tool use, persistent memory, and interaction with untrusted web content. In this survey, we provide a transition-oriented view from Secure Agentic AI to a Secure Agentic Web. We first summarize a component-aligned threat taxonomy covering prompt abuse, environment injection, memory attacks, toolchain abuse, model tampering, and agent network attacks. We then review defense strategies, including prompt hardening, safety-aware decoding, privilege control for tools and APIs, runtime monitoring, continuous red-teaming, and protocol-level security mechanisms. We further discuss how these threats and mitigations escalate in the Agentic Web, where delegation chains, cross-domain interactions, and protocol-mediated ecosystems amplify risks via propagation and composition. Finally, we highlight open challenges for web-scale deployment, such as interoperable identity and authorization, provenance and traceability, ecosystem-level response, and scalable evaluation under adaptive adversaries. Our goal is to connect recent empirical findings with system-level requirements, and to outline practical research directions toward trustworthy agent ecosystems.

title: Rate-Distortion Signatures of Generalization and Information Trade-offs
summary: Generalization to novel visual conditions remains a central challenge for both human and machine vision, yet standard robustness metrics offer limited insight into how systems trade accuracy for robustness. We introduce a rate-distortion-theoretic framework that treats stimulus-response behavior as an effective communication channel, derives rate-distortion (RD) frontiers from confusion matrices, and summarizes each system with two interpretable geometric signatures - slope ($β$) and curvature ($κ$) - which capture the marginal cost and abruptness of accuracy-robustness trade-offs. Applying this framework to human psychophysics and 18 deep vision models under controlled image perturbations, we compare generalization geometry across model architectures and training regimes. We find that both biological and artificial systems follow a common lossy-compression principle but occupy systematically different regions of RD space. In particular, humans exhibit smoother, more flexible trade-offs, whereas modern deep networks operate in steeper and more brittle regimes even at matched accuracy. Across training regimes, robustness training induces systematic but dissociable shifts in beta/kappa, revealing cases where improved robustness or accuracy does not translate into more human-like generalization geometry. These results demonstrate that RD geometry provides a compact, model-agnostic lens for comparing generalization behavior across systems beyond standard accuracy-based metrics.

title: Adversarial Query Synthesis via Bayesian Optimization
summary: Benchmark workloads are extremely important to the database management research community, especially as more machine learning components are integrated into database systems. Here, we propose a Bayesian optimization technique to automatically search for difficult benchmark queries, significantly reducing the amount of manual effort usually required. In preliminary experiments, we show that our approach can generate queries with more than double the optimization headroom compared to existing benchmarks.

title: Beyond Length Scaling: Synergizing Breadth and Depth for Generative Reward Models
summary: Recent advancements in Generative Reward Models (GRMs) have demonstrated that scaling the length of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning considerably enhances the reliability of evaluation. However, current works predominantly rely on unstructured length scaling, ignoring the divergent efficacy of different reasoning mechanisms: Breadth-CoT (B-CoT, i.e., multi-dimensional principle coverage) and Depth-CoT (D-CoT, i.e., substantive judgment soundness). To address this, we introduce Mix-GRM, a framework that reconfigures raw rationales into structured B-CoT and D-CoT through a modular synthesis pipeline, subsequently employing Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to internalize and optimize these mechanisms. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that Mix-GRM establishes a new state-of-the-art across five benchmarks, surpassing leading open-source RMs by an average of 8.2\%. Our results reveal a clear divergence in reasoning: B-CoT benefits subjective preference tasks, whereas D-CoT excels in objective correctness tasks. Consequently, misaligning the reasoning mechanism with the task directly degrades performance. Furthermore, we demonstrate that RLVR acts as a switching amplifier, inducing an emergent polarization where the model spontaneously allocates its reasoning style to match task demands. The synthesized data and models are released at \href{https://huggingface.co/collections/DonJoey/mix-grm}{Hugging Face}, and the code is released at \href{https://github.com/Don-Joey/Mix-GRM}{Github}.

title: DualSentinel: A Lightweight Framework for Detecting Targeted Attacks in Black-box LLM via Dual Entropy Lull Pattern
summary: Recent intelligent systems integrate powerful Large Language Models (LLMs) through APIs, but their trustworthiness may be critically undermined by targeted attacks like backdoor and prompt injection attacks, which secretly force LLMs to generate specific malicious sequences. Existing defensive approaches for such threats typically rely on high access rights, impose prohibitive costs, and hinder normal inference, rendering them impractical for real-world scenarios. To solve these limitations, we introduce DualSentinel, a lightweight and unified defense framework that can accurately and promptly detect the activation of targeted attacks alongside the LLM generation process. We first identify a characteristic of compromised LLMs, termed Entropy Lull: when a targeted attack successfully hijacks the generation process, the LLM exhibits a distinct period of abnormally low and stable token probability entropy, indicating it is following a fixed path rather than making creative choices. DualSentinel leverages this pattern by developing an innovative dual-check approach. It first employs a magnitude and trend-aware monitoring method to proactively and sensitively flag an entropy lull pattern at runtime. Upon such flagging, it triggers a lightweight yet powerful secondary verification based on task-flipping. An attack is confirmed only if the entropy lull pattern persists across both the original and the flipped task, proving that the LLM's output is coercively controlled. Extensive evaluations show that DualSentinel is both highly effective (superior detection accuracy with near-zero false positives) and remarkably efficient (negligible additional cost), offering a truly practical path toward securing deployed LLMs. The source code can be accessed at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18479273.

title: Cryo-Bench: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Cryosphere Applications
summary: Geo-Foundation Models (GFMs) have been evaluated across diverse Earth observation task including multiple domains and have demonstrated strong potential of producing reliable maps even with sparse labels. However, benchmarking GFMs for Cryosphere applications has remained limited, primarily due to the lack of suitable evaluation datasets. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{Cryo-Bench}, a benchmark compiled to evaluate GFM performance across key Cryospheric components. Cryo-Bench includes debris-covered glaciers, glacial lakes, sea ice, and calving fronts, spanning multiple sensors and broad geographic regions. We evaluate 14 GFMs alongside UNet and ViT baselines to assess their advantages, limitations, and optimal usage strategies. With a frozen encoder, UNet achieves the highest average mIoU of \textbf{66.38}, followed by TerraMind at \textbf{64.02} across five evluation dataset included in Cryo-Bench. In the few-shot setting (10\% input data), GFMs such as DOFA and TerraMind outperform UNet, achieving mIoU scores of \textbf{59.53}, \textbf{56.62}, and \textbf{56.60}, respectively, comapred to U-Net's 56.60. When fully finetuning GFMs, we observe inconsistent performance across datasets and models. However, tuning learning rate along with finetuning substantially improves GFM performance. For example, evaluation on two representative datasets (GLID and CaFFe) shows an average relative improvement of \textbf{12.77\%}. Despite having minimal Cryosphere representation in their pretraining data, GFMs exhibit notable domain adaptation capabilities and produce meaningful results across tasks. Based on our findings, We recommend encoder fine-tuning with hyperparameter optimization optimization to achieve the best possible performance, while using frozen encoders when users need quick results without extensive experimentation.(\href{https://github.com/Sk-2103/Cryo-Bench}{GitHub}).

title: SkeleGuide: Explicit Skeleton Reasoning for Context-Aware Human-in-Place Image Synthesis
summary: Generating realistic and structurally plausible human images into existing scenes remains a significant challenge for current generative models, which often produce artifacts like distorted limbs and unnatural poses. We attribute this systemic failure to an inability to perform explicit reasoning over human skeletal structure. To address this, we introduce SkeleGuide, a novel framework built upon explicit skeletal reasoning. Through joint training of its reasoning and rendering stages, SkeleGuide learns to produce an internal pose that acts as a strong structural prior, guiding the synthesis towards high structural integrity. For fine-grained user control, we introduce PoseInverter, a module that decodes this internal latent pose into an explicit and editable format. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SkeleGuide significantly outperforms both specialized and general-purpose models in generating high-fidelity, contextually-aware human images. Our work provides compelling evidence that explicitly modeling skeletal structure is a fundamental step towards robust and plausible human image synthesis.

title: Markovian ODE-guided scoring can assess the quality of offline reasoning traces in language models
summary: Reasoning traces produced by generative language models are increasingly used for tasks ranging from mathematical problem solving to automated fact checking. However, existing evaluation methods remain largely mechanical and fail to capture human-centric notions of reasoning quality in a way that generalizes across varied and progressively degraded reasoning. We introduce MarODE, an offline evaluation framework that assigns quality scores to reasoning traces. Its effectiveness is assessed using human-centric perturbations and human judgments, which jointly evaluate the fundamental dimensions of an evaluation metric - goodness and soundness. The approach is grounded in a Markovian formulation of reasoning progression and an ordinary differential equation based characterization of trace dynamics, enabling efficient evaluation of reasoning quality. In a large-scale evaluation, MarODE outperforms existing baselines by over 250% under Somers' D correlation. Our results emphasize the value of theory-driven evaluation frameworks as reasoning traces become central to language model-based systems.

title: KERV: Kinematic-Rectified Speculative Decoding for Embodied VLA Models
comments: This paper has been accepted by DAC 2026
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models build a token-domain robot control paradigm, yet suffer from low speed. Speculative Decoding (SD) is an optimization strategy that can boost inference speed. Two key issues emerge when integrating VLA and SD: first, SD relies on re-inference to address token errors, which is computationally expensive; second, to mitigate token errors, the acceptance threshold in SD requires careful adjustment. Existing works fail to address the above two issues effectively. Meanwhile, as the bridge between AI and the physical world, existing embodied intelligence has overlooked the application of robotic kinematics. To address these issues, we innovatively combine token-domain VLA models with kinematic-domain prediction for SD, proposing a kinematic-rectified SD framework named KERV. We employ a kinematics-based Kalman Filter to predict actions and compensate for SD errors, avoiding costly re-inference. Moreover, we design a kinematics-based adjustment strategy to dynamically rectify the acceptance threshold, addressing the difficulty of threshold determination. Experimental results across diverse tasks and environments demonstrate that KERV achieves 27%~37% acceleration with nearly no Success Rate loss.

title: InterCoG: Towards Spatially Precise Image Editing with Interleaved Chain-of-Grounding Reasoning
summary: Emerging unified editing models have demonstrated strong capabilities in general object editing tasks. However, it remains a significant challenge to perform fine-grained editing in complex multi-entity scenes, particularly those where targets are not visually salient and require spatial reasoning. To this end, we propose InterCoG, a novel text-vision Interleaved Chain-of-Grounding reasoning framework for fine-grained image editing in complex real-world scenes. The key insight of InterCoG is to first perform object position reasoning solely within text that includes spatial relation details to explicitly deduce the location and identity of the edited target. It then conducts visual grounding via highlighting the editing targets with generated bounding boxes and masks in pixel space, and finally rewrites the editing description to specify the intended outcomes. To further facilitate this paradigm, we propose two auxiliary training modules: multimodal grounding reconstruction supervision and multimodal grounding reasoning alignment to enforce spatial localization accuracy and reasoning interpretability, respectively. We also construct GroundEdit-45K, a dataset comprising 45K grounding-oriented editing samples with detailed reasoning annotations, and GroundEdit-Bench for grounding-aware editing evaluation. Extensive experiments substantiate the superiority of our approach in highly precise edits under spatially intricate and multi-entity scenes.

AI.title_translation: InterCoG：通过交错链式定位推理实现空间精确图像编辑
AI.tldr: InterCoG提出了一种文本-视觉交错链式定位推理框架，用于复杂多实体场景中的精细图像编辑，通过文本中的空间关系推理目标位置，然后进行视觉定位并重写编辑描述，辅以两个辅助训练模块和构建的数据集，实现了空间复杂场景下高度精确的编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有统一编辑模型在复杂多实体场景中的精细编辑能力有限，特别是当目标不突出且需要空间推理时，这是一个重大挑战。
AI.method: InterCoG框架通过以下步骤实现：1. 纯文本中的对象位置推理，利用空间关系细节推断编辑目标的位置和身份。2. 通过在像素空间中用生成的边界框和掩码突出显示编辑目标进行视觉定位。3. 重写编辑描述以明确预期结果。此外，提出了多模态定位重建监督和多模态定位推理对齐两个辅助训练模块，分别用于加强空间定位精度和推理可解释性。还构建了包含45K定位导向编辑样本的GroundEdit-45K数据集和用于定位感知编辑评估的GroundEdit-Bench。
AI.result: 广泛的实验证明了InterCoG在空间复杂和多实体场景中实现高度精确编辑的优越性。
AI.conclusion: InterCoG通过其交错链式定位推理框架和辅助训练模块，有效地解决了复杂场景中精细图像编辑的空间精度挑战，并在空间复杂的多实体场景中展现出卓越的编辑能力。
AI.translation: 新兴的统一编辑模型在通用对象编辑任务中展示了强大的能力。然而，在复杂的多实体场景中执行精细编辑仍然是一个重大挑战，特别是那些目标不突出且需要空间推理的场景。为此，我们提出了InterCoG，一个新颖的文本-视觉交错链式定位推理框架，用于复杂现实世界场景中的精细图像编辑。InterCoG的关键在于首先在包含空间关系细节的纯文本中进行对象位置推理，以明确推断被编辑目标的位置和身份。然后，它通过在像素空间中用生成的边界框和掩码突出显示编辑目标来进行视觉定位，最后重写编辑描述以明确预期的结果。为了进一步促进这种范式，我们提出了两个辅助训练模块：多模态定位重建监督和多模态定位推理对齐，分别用于强制执行空间定位精度和推理可解释性。我们还构建了GroundEdit-45K，一个包含45K定位导向编辑样本及详细推理标注的数据集，以及用于定位感知编辑评估的GroundEdit-Bench。广泛的实验证实了我们方法在空间复杂和多实体场景中高度精确编辑方面的优越性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了InterCoG，一个用于复杂现实世界场景中精细图像编辑的文本-视觉交错链式定位推理框架。InterCoG首先在文本中进行对象位置推理，以明确目标位置和身份，然后通过视觉定位生成边界框和掩码，并重写编辑描述。为支持此范式，引入了多模态定位重建监督和多模态定位推理对齐两个辅助训练模块，并构建了GroundEdit-45K数据集和GroundEdit-Bench评估基准。实验证明了该方法在空间复杂和多实体场景中实现高度精确编辑的卓越性。
AI.keywords: 图像编辑, 空间推理, 视觉定位, 链式定位, 多实体场景
AI.comments: InterCoG的创新之处在于其独特的文本-视觉交错链式定位推理框架，它将文本中的空间关系推理与视觉定位相结合，有效解决了复杂场景中精细图像编辑的难题。辅助训练模块和专门构建的数据集也大大提升了模型的性能和可解释性。这项工作对于推动图像编辑技术在真实世界复杂场景中的应用具有重要意义。

title: Battery Discharge Modeling for Electric Vehicles: A Hybrid Physics-based Residual Learning Approach
summary: The growing integration of electric vehicle (EV) fleets into transportation services and energy systems requires accurate modeling of battery discharge and state-of-charge (SoC) evolution to ensure reliable vehicle operation and grid coordination. Existing approaches face a trade-off between interpretable but simplified physics-based models and data-driven methods that demand large datasets and may lack physical consistency. In this paper, we propose a hybrid physics-based residual learning framework for EV battery discharge modeling. A vehicle dynamics model based on force-balance equations provides an interpretable baseline estimate of energy consumption and SoC evolution, capturing aerodynamic drag, rolling resistance, and regenerative braking. A neural network residual learner then corrects discrepancies caused by complex factors such as traffic conditions and driver behavior. Experimental results on $1,500$ trip scenarios demonstrate that the proposed approach reduces the mean absolute percentage error to approximately $0.8\%$, significantly outperforming physics-only models while preserving physical interpretability and computational efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 电动汽车电池放电建模：一种混合物理基残差学习方法
AI.tldr: 提出一种混合物理基残差学习框架，结合车辆动力学模型和神经网络，实现电动汽车电池放电和SoC演变的高精度建模，同时保持可解释性和计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有电动汽车电池放电和SoC建模方法在可解释的物理模型（过于简化）和数据驱动模型（需要大数据集且可能缺乏物理一致性）之间存在权衡，需要更准确且可靠的模型来确保车辆运行和电网协调。
AI.method: 提出一种混合物理基残差学习框架。首先，使用基于力平衡方程的车辆动力学模型提供能量消耗和SoC演变的基线估计，该模型考虑空气动力阻力、滚动阻力及再生制动。然后，利用神经网络残差学习器纠正由交通状况和驾驶行为等复杂因素引起的差异。
AI.result: 在1,500个行程场景的实验中，所提出的方法将平均绝对百分比误差降低到约0.8%，显著优于纯物理模型，同时保持物理可解释性和计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 该混合物理基残差学习方法能显著提高电动汽车电池放电建模的精度，同时保留物理可解释性和计算效率，解决了现有方法在精度和可解释性之间的权衡问题。
AI.translation: 随着电动汽车（EV）车队日益融入交通服务和能源系统，准确建模电池放电和荷电状态（SoC）演变对于确保车辆可靠运行和电网协调至关重要。现有方法面临一个权衡：可解释但简化的物理模型与需要大数据集且可能缺乏物理一致性的数据驱动方法。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于电动汽车电池放电建模的混合物理基残差学习框架。基于力平衡方程的车辆动力学模型提供能量消耗和SoC演变的可解释基线估计，捕捉空气动力阻力、滚动阻力以及再生制动。然后，神经网络残差学习器纠正由交通状况和驾驶行为等复杂因素引起的差异。在1,500个行程场景的实验结果表明，所提出的方法将平均绝对百分比误差降低到约0.8%，显著优于纯物理模型，同时保持物理可解释性和计算效率。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种用于电动汽车电池放电建模的混合物理基残差学习框架。该框架结合了基于力平衡方程的车辆动力学模型，以提供可解释的能量消耗和SoC演变基线估计，并利用神经网络残差学习器修正复杂因素造成的误差。实验结果显示，该方法将平均绝对百分比误差降至约0.8%，显著优于纯物理模型，且同时保持物理可解释性和计算效率。
AI.keywords: 电动汽车, 电池放电建模, 荷电状态（SoC）, 混合模型, 残差学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将传统物理模型与现代机器学习技术相结合，有效解决了电动汽车电池放电建模中精度与可解释性之间的矛盾。通过残差学习，模型能够从复杂数据中学习未被物理模型捕获的动态，同时保持了物理过程的透明度，这对于实际应用中的故障诊断和系统优化非常重要。

title: Jump Like A Squirrel: Optimized Execution Step Order for Anytime Random Forest Inference
summary:
Due to their efficiency and small size, decision trees and random forests are popular machine learning models used for classification on resource-constrained systems. In such systems, the available execution time for inference in a random forest might not be sufficient for a complete model execution. Ideally, the already gained prediction confidence should be retained. An anytime algorithm is designed to be able to be aborted anytime, while giving a result with an increasing quality over time. Previous approaches have realized random forests as anytime algorithms on the granularity of trees, stopping after some but not all trees of a forest have been executed. However, due to the way decision trees subdivide the sample space in every step, an increase in prediction quality is achieved with every additional step in one tree. In this paper, we realize decision trees and random forest as anytime algorithms on the granularity of single steps in trees. This approach opens a design space to define the step order in a forest, which has the potential to optimize the mean accuracy. We propose the Optimal Order, which finds a step order with a maximal mean accuracy in exponential runtime and the polynomial runtime heuristics Forward Squirrel Order and Backward Squirrel Order, which greedily maximize the accuracy for each additional step taken down and up the trees, respectively.
  Our evaluation shows, that the Backward Squirrel Order performs $\sim94\%$ as well as the Optimal Order and $\sim99\%$ as well as all other step orders.

AI.title_translation: 像松鼠一样跳跃：用于实时随机森林推理的优化执行步骤顺序
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在决策树和随机森林中实现实时算法的新方法，即在单个步骤的粒度上进行，而不是在树的粒度上。引入了“最优顺序”算法以及多项式时间启发式算法“前向松鼠顺序”和“后向松鼠顺序”来优化平均准确率。评估显示，后向松鼠顺序表现接近最优顺序和其他所有步骤顺序。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的系统中，随机森林的推理执行时间可能不足以完成整个模型执行。现有的实时随机森林算法在树的粒度上停止，但决策树在每个额外步骤中都能提高预测质量。因此，需要一种在更细粒度（单步）上实现实时算法的方法，以在任何时候都能保留已获得的预测置信度并优化平均准确率。
AI.method: 本文将决策树和随机森林实现为在树中单个步骤粒度上的实时算法。这开辟了一个设计空间来定义森林中的步骤顺序，以优化平均准确率。提出了：1. 最优顺序（Optimal Order）：在指数运行时内找到具有最大平均准确率的步骤顺序。2. 前向松鼠顺序（Forward Squirrel Order）：多项式运行时启发式算法，贪婪地最大化向下遍历树的每一步的准确率。3. 后向松鼠顺序（Backward Squirrel Order）：多项式运行时启发式算法，贪婪地最大化向上遍历树的每一步的准确率。
AI.result: 评估结果表明，后向松鼠顺序（Backward Squirrel Order）的表现约为最优顺序（Optimal Order）的94%，并且与其他所有步骤顺序的表现约为99%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在决策树和随机森林中实现实时算法的单步粒度，并采用优化的步骤顺序，可以显著提高资源受限系统中的预测准确率。特别是，后向松鼠顺序提供了一种高效且接近最优的解决方案。
AI.translation: 由于其效率和小型化，决策树和随机森林是流行的机器学习模型，用于资源受限系统上的分类。在此类系统中，随机森林中用于推理的可用执行时间可能不足以完成完整的模型执行。理想情况下，应该保留已经获得的预测置信度。实时算法（anytime algorithm）被设计为可以随时中止，同时随着时间的推移提供质量不断提高的结果。以前的方法在树的粒度上实现了随机森林的实时算法，在执行了一些但并非所有森林中的树之后停止。然而，由于决策树在每一步中细分样本空间的方式，在树中的每一步都会提高预测质量。在本文中，我们将决策树和随机森林实现为在树中单个步骤粒度上的实时算法。这种方法开辟了一个设计空间来定义森林中的步骤顺序，这有可能优化平均准确率。我们提出了最优顺序（Optimal Order），它以指数运行时找到具有最大平均准确率的步骤顺序，以及多项式运行时启发式算法前向松鼠顺序（Forward Squirrel Order）和后向松鼠顺序（Backward Squirrel Order），它们分别贪婪地最大化了树中每一步（向下和向上）的准确率。我们的评估表明，后向松鼠顺序的表现约为最优顺序的94%，并且与其他所有步骤顺序的表现约为99%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种在决策树和随机森林中实现实时（anytime）算法的新范式，即在单个决策步骤的粒度上进行，而非传统的树粒度。这种方法旨在为资源受限系统提供更灵活的推理能力，即使在执行时间不足时也能最大化预测准确率。研究引入了“最优顺序”算法来理论上最大化平均准确率，并提出了两种多项式时间启发式算法：“前向松鼠顺序”和“后向松鼠顺序”。实验结果表明，“后向松鼠顺序”在性能上与最优解非常接近（约94%），并且优于其他所有步骤顺序（约99%），为实时随机森林推理提供了一个高效且实用的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 实时算法, 随机森林, 决策树, 步骤顺序优化, 资源受限系统
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将实时算法的概念从随机森林的“树”粒度细化到“单个步骤”粒度，这为在资源受限环境中更精细地控制推理过程提供了可能性。这种方法极大地扩展了实时算法在决策树模型中的应用潜力。提出的启发式算法，特别是“后向松鼠顺序”，在保证接近最优性能的同时，提供了实际可行的多项式时间复杂度，这对于实际部署至关重要。该研究对于在边缘计算、嵌入式系统等对实时性和资源有严格要求的场景下部署随机森林模型具有重要意义。

title: SafeSci: Safety Evaluation of Large Language Models in Science Domains and Beyond
summary: The success of large language models (LLMs) in scientific domains has heightened safety concerns, prompting numerous benchmarks to evaluate their scientific safety. Existing benchmarks often suffer from limited risk coverage and a reliance on subjective evaluation. To address these problems, we introduce SafeSci, a comprehensive framework for safety evaluation and enhancement in scientific contexts. SafeSci comprises SafeSciBench, a multi-disciplinary benchmark with 0.25M samples, and SafeSciTrain, a large-scale dataset containing 1.5M samples for safety enhancement. SafeSciBench distinguishes between safety knowledge and risk to cover extensive scopes and employs objective metrics such as deterministically answerable questions to mitigate evaluation bias. We evaluate 24 advanced LLMs, revealing critical vulnerabilities in current models. We also observe that LLMs exhibit varying degrees of excessive refusal behaviors on safety-related issues. For safety enhancement, we demonstrate that fine-tuning on SafeSciTrain significantly enhances the safety alignment of models. Finally, we argue that knowledge is a double-edged sword, and determining the safety of a scientific question should depend on specific context, rather than universally categorizing it as safe or unsafe. Our work provides both a diagnostic tool and a practical resource for building safer scientific AI systems.

AI.title_translation: SafeSci：科学领域及其他领域大型语言模型安全评估
AI.tldr: SafeSci是一个新的、全面的框架，用于评估和增强科学领域LLM的安全性，它包含一个大规模客观基准（SafeSciBench）和一个增强数据集（SafeSciTrain），评估发现现有模型存在安全漏洞和过度拒绝问题，同时强调安全判断应上下文相关。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在科学领域的成功引发了安全担忧，但现有的基准测试存在风险覆盖有限和依赖主观评估的问题。需要一个更全面、更客观的科学安全评估方法。
AI.method: 引入SafeSci框架，包括SafeSciBench（包含0.25M样本的多学科基准，使用确定性可回答问题等客观指标）和SafeSciTrain（包含1.5M样本的安全增强数据集）。使用SafeSciBench评估了24个先进的LLM。
AI.result: 评估显示了当前模型中存在的关键漏洞，并观察到LLMs在安全相关问题上表现出不同程度的过度拒绝行为。使用SafeSciTrain进行微调能显著增强模型的安全对齐能力。
AI.conclusion: 知识是一把双刃剑，科学问题的安全性应取决于具体情境，而非普遍地将其归类为安全或不安全。SafeSci为构建更安全的科学人工智能系统提供了诊断工具和实用资源。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在科学领域的成功加剧了安全担忧，促使了许多基准测试来评估其科学安全性。现有基准通常存在风险覆盖有限和依赖主观评估的缺点。为解决这些问题，我们引入了SafeSci，一个用于科学环境中的安全评估和增强的综合框架。SafeSci包括SafeSciBench，一个包含25万个样本的多学科基准，以及SafeSciTrain，一个包含150万个样本的大规模安全增强数据集。SafeSciBench区分安全知识和风险以覆盖广泛范围，并采用确定性可回答问题等客观指标来减轻评估偏差。我们评估了24个先进的LLM，揭示了当前模型中的关键漏洞。我们还观察到LLMs在安全相关问题上表现出不同程度的过度拒绝行为。对于安全增强，我们证明了在SafeSciTrain上进行微调能显著增强模型的安全对齐能力。最后，我们认为知识是一把双刃剑，科学问题的安全性应取决于具体情境，而不是普遍地将其归类为安全或不安全。我们的工作为构建更安全的科学人工智能系统提供了诊断工具和实用资源。
AI.summary: 为解决现有科学领域LLM安全评估基准的局限性，本文提出了SafeSci框架，它包含大规模多学科基准SafeSciBench和用于安全增强的数据集SafeSciTrain。SafeSciBench采用客观指标以减少偏差，评估结果揭示了当前LLMs的关键安全漏洞和过度拒绝行为。研究表明，使用SafeSciTrain微调能有效提升模型安全对齐度，并主张科学问题的安全性判断应依赖于具体上下文。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 安全评估, 科学领域, SafeSci, 安全对齐
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一个全面且客观的科学领域LLM安全评估框架SafeSci，它不仅包含了大规模多学科基准SafeSciBench，还引入了用于安全增强的数据集SafeSciTrain，并强调了安全评估应依赖于具体上下文而非一概而论的观点，这对于未来科学AI系统的安全构建至关重要。然而，抽象中没有明确说明“Beyond”部分具体指代什么领域。

title: IDProxy: Cold-Start CTR Prediction for Ads and Recommendation at Xiaohongshu with Multimodal LLMs
summary: Click-through rate (CTR) models in advertising and recommendation systems rely heavily on item ID embeddings, which struggle in item cold-start settings. We present IDProxy, a solution that leverages multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to generate proxy embeddings from rich content signals, enabling effective CTR prediction for new items without usage data. These proxies are explicitly aligned with the existing ID embedding space and are optimized end-to-end under CTR objectives together with the ranking model, allowing seamless integration into existing large-scale ranking pipelines. Offline experiments and online A/B tests demonstrate the effectiveness of IDProxy, which has been successfully deployed in both Content Feed and Display Ads features of Xiaohongshu's Explore Feed, serving hundreds of millions of users daily.

AI.title_translation: IDProxy：小红书多模态大语言模型在广告和推荐冷启动点击率预测中的应用
AI.tldr: IDProxy利用多模态大语言模型为新商品生成代理嵌入，解决广告和推荐系统中冷启动点击率预测问题，已成功部署并服务数亿用户。
AI.motivation: 广告和推荐系统中的点击率（CTR）模型严重依赖商品ID嵌入，但在商品冷启动（即新商品缺乏使用数据）场景下效果不佳。
AI.method: IDProxy利用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）从丰富的 H内容信号中生成代理嵌入。这些代理嵌入与现有的ID嵌入空间明确对齐，并与排序模型一起在CTR目标下进行端到端优化，从而无缝集成到现有的大规模排序管道中。
AI.result: 离线实验和在线A/B测试证明了IDProxy的有效性。该方案已成功部署在小红书探索页面的内容信息流和展示广告功能中，每天服务数亿用户。
AI.conclusion: IDProxy通过利用多模态大语言模型有效解决了广告和推荐系统中的商品冷启动点击率预测问题，并已在大规模生产环境中成功部署和验证。
AI.translation: 广告和推荐系统中的点击率（CTR）模型严重依赖商品ID嵌入，这在商品冷启动设置中表现不佳。我们提出了IDProxy，一个利用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）从丰富内容信号生成代理嵌入的解决方案，从而实现对没有使用数据的新商品的有效CTR预测。这些代理明确地与现有ID嵌入空间对齐，并在CTR目标下与排序模型一起进行端到端优化，从而实现与现有大规模排序管道的无缝集成。离线实验和在线A/B测试证明了IDProxy的有效性，该方案已成功部署在小红书探索页面的内容信息流和展示广告功能中，每天服务数亿用户。
AI.summary: IDProxy是一个针对广告和推荐系统商品冷启动CTR预测的解决方案。它利用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）从内容信号生成代理嵌入，这些嵌入与现有ID嵌入空间对齐，并与排序模型一起进行端到端优化，以实现对新商品的有效CTR预测。该系统已在小红书成功部署，并通过离线和在线测试验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 冷启动, CTR预测, 多模态大语言模型, 推荐系统, 广告
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于利用多模态大语言模型解决推荐系统中长期存在的冷启动问题，并通过生成与现有ID嵌入空间对齐的代理嵌入，实现了与现有大规模排序系统的无缝集成。其在小红书的成功部署和大规模应用，证明了其实用性和工业价值。

title: FAST-DIPS: Adjoint-Free Analytic Steps and Hard-Constrained Likelihood Correction for Diffusion-Prior Inverse Problems
summary: Training-free diffusion priors enable inverse-problem solvers without retraining, but for nonlinear forward operators data consistency often relies on repeated derivatives or inner optimization/MCMC loops with conservative step sizes, incurring many iterations and denoiser/score evaluations. We propose a training-free solver that replaces these inner loops with a hard measurement-space feasibility constraint (closed-form projection) and an analytic, model-optimal step size, enabling a small, fixed compute budget per noise level. Anchored at the denoiser prediction, the correction is approximated via an adjoint-free, ADMM-style splitting with projection and a few steepest-descent updates, using one VJP and either one JVP or a forward-difference probe, followed by backtracking and decoupled re-annealing. We prove local model optimality and descent under backtracking for the step-size rule, and derive an explicit KL bound for mode-substitution re-annealing under a local Gaussian conditional surrogate. We also develop a latent variant and a one-parameter pixel$\rightarrow$latent hybrid schedule. Experiments achieve competitive PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS with up to 19.5$\times$ speedup, without hand-coded adjoints or inner MCMC.

AI.title_translation: FAST-DIPS：用于扩散先验逆问题的无伴随解析步进和硬约束似然校正
AI.tldr: FAST-DIPS通过用硬约束和无伴随的解析步长替代扩散先验求解器中的耗时循环（如MCMC），实现了逆问题求解的计算效率大幅提升（最高19.5倍加速），同时保持了结果质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于训练无关的扩散先验的逆问题求解器，在处理非线性正演算子时，依赖于重复的导数计算或内部优化/MCMC循环，这导致了大量的迭代和去噪器/得分函数的评估，效率低下。目标是开发一个更快的、无需重新训练的求解器。
AI.method: FAST-DIPS通过以下方法解决问题：1. 用硬测量空间可行性约束（闭式投影）替换内部循环。2. 引入解析的、模型最优的步长。3. 采用无伴随的、ADMM风格的分裂方法，结合投影和少数几次最速下降更新，锚定在去噪器预测上。4. 使用一个VJP和（一个JVP或一个前向差分探针）。5. 随后进行回溯和解耦的重新退火。6. 提出了潜在变体和一种像素到潜在的混合调度。
AI.result: 实现了高达19.5倍的速度提升，同时保持了与现有方法具有竞争力的PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS指标，且无需手工编码的伴随或内部MCMC。证明了在回溯下步长规则的局部模型最优性和下降性，并推导了在局部高斯条件代理下进行模式替换重新退火的显式KL界限。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，FAST-DIPS在不依赖手工编码的伴随或内部MCMC的情况下，实现了与现有方法具有竞争力的PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS指标，并实现了高达19.5倍的速度提升。
AI.translation: 训练无关的扩散先验使逆问题求解器无需重新训练，但对于非线性正演算子，数据一致性通常依赖于重复的导数计算或带有保守步长的内部优化/MCMC循环，从而带来许多迭代和去噪器/得分函数的评估。我们提出了一种训练无关的求解器，它用一个硬测量空间可行性约束（闭式投影）和一个解析的、模型最优的步长来替代这些内部循环，从而在每个噪声水平下实现较小的、固定的计算预算。该校正以去噪器预测为基础，通过一种无伴随的、ADMM风格的分裂（结合投影和几次最速下降更新）来近似，该过程使用一个VJP和（一个JVP或一个前向差分探针），随后进行回溯和解耦的重新退火。我们证明了在回溯下步长规则的局部模型最优性和下降性，并推导了在局部高斯条件代理下进行模式替换重新退火的显式KL界限。我们还开发了一个潜在变体和一个单参数像素到潜在的混合调度。实验结果表明，在没有手工编码的伴随或内部MCMC的情况下，实现了高达19.5倍的速度提升，同时保持了具有竞争力的PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS指标。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为FAST-DIPS的训练无关扩散先验逆问题求解新方法，它通过引入硬测量空间可行性约束（闭式投影）和无伴随的解析最优步长，取代了传统方法中耗时的内部优化/MCMC循环。该方法采用ADMM风格的分裂和少数几次梯度更新，实现了计算效率的大幅提升，同时在图像重建任务中保持了与现有方法的竞争力。
AI.keywords: 扩散先验, 逆问题, 无伴随, 硬约束, 解析步长
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于使用硬约束和无伴随（Adjoint-Free）的解析步长来替代扩散先验逆问题求解器中耗时的内部优化/MCMC循环，实现了显著的加速，同时保持了与现有方法的竞争力。其局限性可能在于对“局部高斯条件代理”的依赖，以及解析最优性仅在局部范围内证明。

title: TQCodec: Towards neural audio codec for high-fidelity music streaming
summary: We propose TQCodec, a neural audio codec designed for high-bitrate, high-fidelity music streaming. Unlike existing neural codecs that primarily target ultra-low bitrates (<= 16kbps), TQCodec operates at 44.1 kHz and supports bitrates from 32 kbps to 128 kbps, aligning with the standard quality of modern music streaming platforms. The model adopts an encoder-decoder architecture based on SEANet for efficient on-device computation and introduces several enhancements: an imbalanced network design for improved quality with low overhead, SimVQ for mid-frequency detail preservation, and a phase-aware waveform loss. Additionally, we introduce a perception-driven band-wise bit allocation strategy to prioritize perceptually critical lower frequencies. Evaluations on diverse music datasets demonstrate that TQCodec achieves superior audio quality at target bitrates, making it well-suited for high-quality audio applications.

AI.title_translation: TQCodec：面向高保真音乐流的神经音频编解码器
AI.tldr: TQCodec 是一种神经音频编解码器，可在 32-128 kbps 的比特率下实现高保真音乐流，采用 SEANet 架构，并结合了不平衡网络设计、SimVQ、相位感知波形损失和带状比特分配策略。
AI.motivation: 现有神经音频编解码器主要针对超低比特率（<= 16kbps），无法满足现代音乐流媒体平台对高比特率、高保真度的标准质量要求。
AI.method: 采用基于 SEANet 的编码器-解码器架构，并引入了不平衡网络设计、SimVQ（用于中频细节保留）和相位感知波形损失。此外，还提出了一种感知驱动的带状比特分配策略。
AI.result: 在多个音乐数据集上的评估表明，TQCodec 在目标比特率下实现了卓越的音频质量，适用于高质量音频应用。
AI.conclusion: TQCodec 是一种专为高比特率、高保真音乐流设计的神经音频编解码器，其性能优于现有技术。
AI.translation: 我们提出了 TQCodec，这是一种专为高比特率、高保真音乐流设计的神经音频编解码器。与主要针对超低比特率（<= 16kbps）的现有神经编解码器不同，TQCodec 在 44.1 kHz 下运行，并支持从 32 kbps 到 128 kbps 的比特率，这与现代音乐流媒体平台的标准质量相符。该模型采用了基于 SEANet 的编码器-解码器架构，以实现高效的设备内计算，并进行了一些增强：采用不平衡网络设计以在低开销的情况下提高质量，SimVQ 以保留中频细节，以及相位感知波形损失。此外，我们引入了一种感知驱动的带状比特分配策略，以优先考虑感官上关键的低频。在不同音乐数据集上的评估表明，TQCodec 在目标比特率下实现了卓越的音频质量，使其非常适合高质量音频应用。
AI.summary: TQCodec 是一种创新的神经音频编解码器，旨在满足高比特率（32-128 kbps）和高保真音乐流的要求。它基于 SEANet 架构，并集成了不平衡网络设计、SimVQ、相位感知波形损失以及感知驱动的带状比特分配策略，以优化音频质量和效率，特别是在保留中低频细节方面。实验证明 TQCodec 在高比特率下表现优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 神经音频编解码器, 高保真音乐流, TQCodec, SEANet, 感知优化
AI.comments: 该研究解决了现有神经音频编解码器在高比特率下性能不足的问题，通过引入多种创新技术（如不平衡网络、SimVQ、相位感知损失和带状比特分配）显著提高了音频质量。其在 44.1 kHz 和高达 128 kbps 的比特率下运行的能力，使其在实际音乐流媒体应用中具有很高的价值。然而，关于其在不同设备上的实际计算开销和延迟表现，以及与传统编解码器（如 AAC、Opus）在感知上的直接比较，可能需要进一步的探讨。

title: PPEDCRF: Privacy-Preserving Enhanced Dynamic CRF for Location-Privacy Protection for Sequence Videos with Minimal Detection Degradation
summary: Dashcam videos collected by autonomous or assisted-driving systems are increasingly shared for safety auditing and model improvement. Even when explicit GPS metadata are removed, an attacker can still infer the recording location by matching background visual cues (e.g., buildings and road layouts) against large-scale street-view imagery. This paper studies location-privacy leakage under a background-based retrieval attacker, and proposes PPEDCRF, a privacy-preserving enhanced dynamic conditional random field framework that injects calibrated perturbations only into inferred location-sensitive background regions while preserving foreground detection utility. PPEDCRF consists of three components: (i) a dynamic CRF that enforces temporal consistency to discover and track location sensitive regions across frames, (ii) a normalized control penalty (NCP) that allocates perturbation strength according to a hierarchical sensitivity model, and (iii) a utility-preserving noise injection module that minimizes interference to object detection and segmentation. Experiments on public driving datasets demonstrate that PPEDCRF significantly reduces location-retrieval attack success (e.g., Top-k retrieval accuracy) while maintaining competitive detection performance (e.g., mAP and segmentation metrics) compared with common baselines such as global noise, white-noise masking, and feature-based anonymization. The source code is in https://github.com/mabo1215/PPEDCRF.git

AI.title_translation: 用于具有最小检测降级的序列视频的位置隐私保护的隐私保护增强动态CRF
AI.tldr: 为了防止黑客通过分析行车记录仪视频中的背景来推断录制位置，我们开发了 PPEDCRF，它只在视频中“可能泄露位置的背景部分”添加精确的“噪声”，这样既能有效阻止位置被猜到，又能确保视频中的车辆和行人等重要信息（前景）的检测效果不受影响。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶系统的行车记录仪视频在移除 GPS 元数据后，攻击者仍可以通过匹配背景视觉线索（如建筑物和道路布局）来推断录制位置，造成位置隐私泄露。
AI.method: PPEDCRF（隐私保护增强动态条件随机场框架），它包括 (i) 一个动态 CRF 用于跨帧发现和跟踪位置敏感区域，(ii) 一个归一化控制惩罚 (NCP) 根据分层敏感度模型分配扰动强度，以及 (iii) 一个效用保持的噪声注入模块，以最小化对目标检测和分割的干扰。
AI.result: PPEDCRF 显著降低了位置检索攻击的成功率（例如 Top-k 检索准确率），同时保持了具有竞争力的检测性能。
AI.conclusion: PPEDCRF 显著降低了基于背景的检索攻击的成功率，同时与常见的基线方法相比，保持了具有竞争力的检测性能（如 mAP 和分割指标）。
AI.translation: 由自主或辅助驾驶系统收集的行车记录仪视频越来越多地被共享以进行安全审计和模型改进。即使移除了明确的 GPS 元数据，攻击者仍然可以通过将背景视觉线索（例如建筑物和道路布局）与大规模街景图像进行匹配来推断录制位置。本文研究了基于背景检索的攻击下的位置隐私泄露问题，并提出了 PPEDCRF，一种隐私保护增强的动态条件随机场框架，它仅将校准的扰动注入到推断出的位置敏感背景区域，同时保持前景检测的效用。PPEDCRF 由三个组成部分构成：(i) 一个动态 CRF，用于强制执行时间一致性，跨帧发现和跟踪位置敏感区域，(ii) 一个归一化控制惩罚 (NCP)，根据分层敏感度模型分配扰动强度，以及 (iii) 一个效用保持的噪声注入模块，以最小化对目标检测和分割的干扰。在公共驾驶数据集上的实验表明，与全局噪声、白噪声掩蔽和基于特征的匿名化等常见基线相比，PPEDCRF 显著降低了位置检索攻击的成功率（例如 Top-k 检索准确率），同时保持了具有竞争力的检测性能（例如 mAP 和分割指标）。源代码位于 https://github.com/mabo1215/PPEDCRF.git
AI.summary: 本文针对自动驾驶视频中基于背景视觉线索的位置隐私泄露问题，提出了一种名为 PPEDCRF 的隐私保护增强动态条件随机场框架。PPEDCRF 通过动态 CRF 跟踪位置敏感区域，并利用 NCP 模型分配扰动强度，仅在这些敏感背景区域注入校准的扰动，从而在最小化对目标检测和分割效用的影响下，有效降低了位置检索攻击的成功率。
AI.keywords: 位置隐私保护, 动态条件随机场, 扰动注入, 目标检测, 序列视频
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种选择性地对视频中敏感的背景区域注入扰动的方法（PPEDCRF），而不是对整个视频进行全局处理，从而在保护位置隐私的同时最大限度地保持了目标检测等下游任务的性能。其重要性在于解决了自动驾驶视频共享中的关键隐私泄露问题。限制在于其性能依赖于对“位置敏感区域”的准确识别和跟踪。

title: Preference Score Distillation: Leveraging 2D Rewards to Align Text-to-3D Generation with Human Preference
summary: Human preference alignment presents a critical yet underexplored challenge for diffusion models in text-to-3D generation. Existing solutions typically require task-specific fine-tuning, posing significant hurdles in data-scarce 3D domains. To address this, we propose Preference Score Distillation (PSD), an optimization-based framework that leverages pretrained 2D reward models for human-aligned text-to-3D synthesis without 3D training data. Our key insight stems from the incompatibility of pixel-level gradients: due to the absence of noisy samples during reward model training, direct application of 2D reward gradients disturbs the denoising process. Noticing that similar issue occurs in the naive classifier guidance in conditioned diffusion models, we fundamentally rethink preference alignment as a classifier-free guidance (CFG)-style mechanism through our implicit reward model. Furthermore, recognizing that frozen pretrained diffusion models constrain performance, we introduce an adaptive strategy to co-optimize preference scores and negative text embeddings. By incorporating CFG during optimization, online refinement of negative text embeddings dynamically enhances alignment. To our knowledge, we are the first to bridge human preference alignment with CFG theory under score distillation framework. Experiments demonstrate the superiority of PSD in aesthetic metrics, seamless integration with diverse pipelines, and strong extensibility.

AI.title_translation: 偏好分数蒸馏：利用二维奖励使文本到三维生成与人类偏好对齐
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为偏好分数蒸馏（PSD）的框架，利用预训练的二维奖励模型，在没有三维训练数据的情况下，通过优化实现文本到三维生成与人类偏好的对齐。该方法将偏好对齐视为一种类似分类器无关引导（CFG）的机制，并引入了一种自适应策略来优化偏好分数和负文本嵌入，以提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到三维生成方法在与人类偏好对齐方面存在挑战，通常需要特定任务的微调，而在数据稀缺的三维领域难以实现。
AI.method: 提出偏好分数蒸馏（PSD）框架，利用预训练的二维奖励模型，将偏好对齐视为一种类似分类器无关引导（CFG）的机制，并通过自适应策略协同优化偏好分数和负文本嵌入。
AI.result: PSD在美学指标上表现优越，能够无缝集成到不同的生成流程中，并具有很强的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: PSD成功地利用二维奖励模型实现了文本到三维生成与人类偏好的对齐，克服了数据稀缺的限制，并为该领域的研究提供了新的方向。
AI.translation: 人类偏好对齐是扩散模型在文本到三维生成领域一个关键但探索不足的挑战。现有解决方案通常需要特定任务的微调，在数据稀缺的三维领域带来了显著的障碍。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了偏好分数蒸馏（PSD），一个基于优化的框架，它利用预训练的二维奖励模型，在没有3D训练数据的情况下实现与人类对齐的文本到三维合成。我们的关键见解源于像素级梯度的不兼容性：由于奖励模型训练期间缺乏噪声样本，直接应用2D奖励梯度会干扰去噪过程。注意到在条件扩散模型中的朴素分类器引导中出现了类似的问题，我们通过我们隐式奖励模型将偏好对齐根本性地视为一种类似分类器无关引导（CFG）的机制。此外，认识到冻结的预训练扩散模型限制了性能，我们引入了一种自适应策略来协同优化偏好分数和负文本嵌入。通过在优化过程中引入CFG，负文本嵌入的在线精调能够动态地增强对齐。据我们所知，我们是第一个在分数蒸馏框架下将人类偏好对齐与CFG理论联系起来的研究。实验证明了PSD在美学指标、与各种流程的无缝集成以及强大的可扩展性方面的优越性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了偏好分数蒸馏（PSD）框架，一种创新的优化方法，用于解决文本到三维生成中的人类偏好对齐问题。PSD利用预训练的二维奖励模型，无需三维训练数据，通过将偏好对齐视为一种类似分类器无关引导（CFG）的机制来实现。此外，该框架还引入了一种自适应策略，通过协同优化偏好分数和负文本嵌入来提升性能。实验结果表明，PSD在美学质量、易集成性和可扩展性方面均表现出色。
AI.keywords: 偏好分数蒸馏, 文本到三维生成, 人类偏好对齐, 分类器无关引导, 奖励模型
AI.comments: 这项研究在文本到三维生成领域取得了重要进展，成功解决了人类偏好对齐的难题。通过利用二维奖励模型和引入类似CFG的机制，PSD在数据稀缺的情况下实现了高性能的生成。其创新性在于将偏好对齐与CFG理论相结合，并提出了自适应策略来优化生成过程。该方法具有广泛的应用前景，但也可能存在对预训练模型依赖性强、计算成本高等局限性。

title: MigMate: A VS Code Extension for LLM-based Library Migration of Python Projects
comments: 6 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables, 3rd International Workshop on Integrated Development Environments (IDE 2026)
summary: Modern software relies heavily on third-party software libraries to streamline the development process. The act of switching one library for a similar counterpart, called library migration, naturally occurs as libraries become outdated or unsuitable for the project. Manually migrating from one library to another is a time-consuming task. Our previous research developed MigrateLib, a command-line LLM-based migration tool that can automate the complete migration process. In this paper, we present our open-source VS Code IDE plugin, MigMate, that builds on MigrateLib by integrating the automated migration process into the developer's existing development environment. MigMate provides an interactive experience, allowing developers to view and confirm changes before they are applied. A preliminary user study shows that plugin usage consistently reduces the time taken to complete a library migration task, and it scores highly on the System Usability Scale.
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables, 3rd International Workshop on Integrated Development Environments (IDE 2026)

AI.title_translation: 用于Python项目LLM驱动的库迁移的VS Code扩展：MigMate
AI.tldr: MigMate是一个VS Code扩展，它将MigrateLib（一个命令行LLM驱动的库迁移工具）集成到开发环境中，提供交互式迁移体验，并通过用户研究证明能有效减少迁移时间并提高可用性。
AI.motivation: 手动进行库迁移耗时耗力，需要将自动化迁移过程集成到开发者的现有环境中，以提高效率和用户体验。
AI.method: 开发了一个名为MigMate的VS Code扩展，该扩展构建在先前的MigrateLib工具之上，将自动化迁移过程集成到IDE中，并提供交互式界面供开发者确认更改。
AI.result: 初步用户研究表明，使用MigMate可以持续减少完成库迁移任务所需的时间，并且在系统可用性量表上得分很高。
AI.conclusion: MigMate通过将其构建的自动化库迁移工具集成到VS Code IDE中，成功地将库迁移过程无缝集成到开发者的工作流程中，并被用户研究证实可以提高效率和可用性。
AI.translation: 现代软件严重依赖第三方软件库来简化开发过程。随着库过时或不再适合项目，将一个库切换到类似替代品（称为库迁移）自然会发生。手动从一个库迁移到另一个库是一项耗时的任务。我们之前的研究开发了MigrateLib，一个基于命令行的LLM驱动的迁移工具，可以自动化完整的迁移过程。在本文中，我们提出了我们的开源VS Code IDE插件MigMate，它通过将自动化迁移过程集成到开发者的现有开发环境中，构建在MigrateLib之上。MigMate提供了一种交互式体验，允许开发者在应用更改之前查看和确认更改。初步的用户研究表明，该插件的使用持续减少了完成库迁移任务所需的时间，并在系统可用性量表中得分很高。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了MigMate，一个VS Code扩展，它将LLM驱动的库迁移功能集成到开发环境中。该工具基于先前的MigrateLib，提供交互式迁移体验，允许开发者在应用更改前进行确认。初步用户研究表明，MigMate能显著减少迁移时间并提高可用性。
AI.keywords: 库迁移, LLM, VS Code扩展, MigMate, 自动化工具
AI.comments: 该研究将现有的LLM驱动的迁移工具MigrateLib成功地集成到一个流行的IDE（VS Code）中，创建了一个名为MigMate的插件。这种集成方法很有价值，因为它直接解决了在开发者的常规工作流程中实现自动化工具的实际挑战。交互式界面和用户研究结果是该工作的亮点，表明了其实用性和有效性。未来的工作可以探索支持更广泛的语言或迁移场景，或者进一步优化迁移的准确性和效率。

title: Graph-centric Cross-model Data Integration and Analytics in a Unified Multi-model Database
summary: Graph-centric cross-model data integration and analytics (GCDIA) refer to tasks that leverage the graph model as a central paradigm to integrate relevant information across heterogeneous data models, such as relational and document, and subsequently perform complex analytics such as regression and similarity computation. As modern applications generate increasingly diverse data and move beyond simple retrieval toward advanced analytical objectives (e.g., prediction and recommendation), GCDIA has become increasingly important. Existing multi-model databases (MMDBs) struggle to efficiently support both integration (GCDI) and analytics (GCDA) in GCDIA. They typically separate graph processing from other models without global optimization for GCDI, while relying on tuple-at-a-time execution for GCDA, leading to limited performance and scalability. To address these limitations, we propose GredoDB, a unified MMDB that natively supports storing graph, relational, and document models, while efficiently processing GCDIA. Specifically, we design 1) topology- and attribute-aware graph operators for efficient predicate-aware traversal, 2) a unified GCDI optimization framework to exploit cross-model correlations, and 3) a parallel GCDA architecture that materializes intermediate results for operator-level execution. Experiments on the widely adopted multi-model benchmark M2Bench demonstrate that, in terms of response time, GredoDB achieves up to 107.89 times and an average of 10.89 times speedup on GCDI, and up to 356.72 times and an average of 37.79 times on GCDA, compared to state-of-the-art (SOTA) MMDBs.

AI.title_translation: 统一多模型数据库中的图中心跨模型数据集成与分析
AI.tldr: 为解决现有多模型数据库在处理图中心跨模型数据集成与分析（GCDIA）时的性能瓶颈，研究人员提出了GredoDB。GredoDB通过统一的架构和优化的算子/框架，在集成和分析任务上均实现了比现有技术高出数十倍的性能加速。
AI.motivation: 现代应用产生的数据日益多样化，并从简单的检索转向高级分析目标（如预测和推荐），使得GCDIA变得越来越重要。然而，现有的多模型数据库（MMDBs）在高效支持GCDIA的集成（GCDI）和分析（GCDA）方面存在困难，通常将图处理与其他模型分离，缺乏全局优化，并且GCDA依赖于逐元组执行，导致性能和可扩展性受限。
AI.method: 设计了1) 拓扑和属性感知的图算子以实现高效的谓词感知遍历，2) 一个统一的GCDI优化框架以利用跨模型相关性，以及 3) 一个并行的GCDA架构，通过物化中间结果来实现算子级别的执行。
AI.result: 在M2Bench基准测试中，与最先进（SOTA）的MMDBs相比，GredoDB在GCDI的响应时间上实现了高达107.89倍和平均10.89倍的加速；在GCDA上实现了高达356.72倍和平均37.79倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: GredoDB是一个统一的多模型数据库，通过特定的设计（拓扑和属性感知的图算子、统一的GCDI优化框架、并行的GCDA架构）有效地解决了现有MMDB在图中心跨模型数据集成与分析（GCDIA）中的性能和可扩展性限制，并在M2Bench基准测试中实现了显著的加速。
AI.translation: 图中心跨模型数据集成与分析在统一的多模型数据库中。图中心跨模型数据集成与分析（GCDIA）指的是利用图模型作为中心范式，整合异构数据模型（如关系型和文档型）中的相关信息，并随后执行复杂分析（如回归和相似性计算）的任务。随着现代应用产生的数据日益多样化，并从简单的检索转向高级分析目标（例如预测和推荐），GCDIA变得越来越重要。现有的多模型数据库（MMDBs）在高效支持GCDIA的集成（GCDI）和分析（GCDA）方面存在困难。它们通常将图处理与其他模型分离，缺乏全局优化以支持GCDI，同时依赖于逐元组执行来支持GCDA，导致性能和可扩展性受限。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了GredoDB，一个统一的MMDB，它原生支持存储图、关系和文档模型，同时高效处理GCDIA。具体来说，我们设计了1) 拓扑和属性感知的图算子以实现高效的谓词感知遍历，2) 一个统一的GCDI优化框架以利用跨模型相关性，以及 3) 一个并行的GCDA架构，通过物化中间结果来实现算子级别的执行。在广泛采用的多模型基准M2Bench上的实验表明，在响应时间方面，与最先进（SOTA）的MMDBs相比，GredoDB在GCDI上实现了高达107.89倍和平均10.89倍的加速，在GCDA上实现了高达356.72倍和平均37.79倍的加速。
AI.summary: 本文针对现代应用中日益重要的图中心跨模型数据集成与分析（GCDIA）需求，提出了GredoDB，一个统一的多模型数据库。GredoDB原生支持图、关系和文档模型，并通过设计专门的图算子、统一的集成优化框架和并行的分析架构，解决了现有MMDB在集成和分析效率上的不足。实验证明GredoDB在GCDI和GCDA任务上相比SOTA系统有显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 图中心跨模型数据集成与分析,多模型数据库,GredoDB,数据集成,图分析
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了GredoDB，一个原生支持图、关系和文档模型并能高效处理图中心跨模型数据集成与分析（GCDIA）的统一多模型数据库。其方法设计了拓扑和属性感知的图算子、统一的GCDI优化框架以及并行的GCDA架构，解决了现有MMDB在集成和分析方面的性能瓶颈。实验结果展示了显著的性能提升。

title: Boosting Entropy with Bell Box Quantization
comments: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
summary: Quantization-Aware Pre-Training (QAPT) is an effective technique to reduce the compute and memory overhead of Deep Neural Networks while improving their energy efficiency on edge devices. Existing QAPT methods produce models stored in compute-efficient data types (e.g. integers) that are not information theoretically optimal (ITO). On the other hand, existing ITO data types (e.g. Quantile/NormalFloat Quantization) are not compute-efficient. We propose BBQ, the first ITO quantization method that is also compute-efficient. BBQ builds on our key insight that since learning is domain-agnostic, the output of a quantizer does not need to reside in the same domain as its input. BBQ performs ITO quantization in its input domain, and returns its output in a compute-efficient domain where ITO data types are mapped to compute-efficient data types. Without sacrificing compute efficiency, BBQ outperforms prior SOTA QAPT methods by a perplexity reduction of up to 2 points for 4-bit models, up to 4 points for 3-bit models, up to 5 points for 2-bit models, and up to 18 points for 1-bit models. Code is available at https://github.com/1733116199/bbq.
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的信息论最优（ITO）且计算高效的量化感知预训练（QAPT）方法BBQ，它通过将量化输出映射到计算高效的域来克服现有方法的局限性，并在各种位宽下显著提高了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的量化感知预训练（QAPT）方法虽然能降低计算和内存开销，但其输出的数据类型并非信息论最优（ITO）。而现有的ITO数据类型又缺乏计算效率。
AI.method: BBQ是一种信息论最优（ITO）且计算高效的量化方法。其核心思想是利用学习的领域无关性，将量化过程的输入和输出置于不同域。BBQ在输入域执行ITO量化，然后将其输出映射到一个计算高效的域，并将ITO数据类型映射到计算高效的数据类型。
AI.result: 在不牺牲计算效率的情况下，BBQ在4位模型上将困惑度降低了2个点，在3位模型上降低了4个点，在2位模型上降低了5个点，在1位模型上降低了18个点，优于现有的SOTA QAPT方法。
AI.conclusion: BBQ是第一个既信息论最优（ITO）又计算高效的量化方法，它通过将量化输出映射到计算高效的域来克服现有方法的局限性，并在各种位宽下显著提高了模型性能。
AI.translation: 量化感知预训练（QAPT）是一种有效的技术，可以在降低深度神经网络的计算和内存开销的同时，提高其在边缘设备上的能效。现有的QAPT方法生成的模型存储在计算高效的数据类型（例如整数）中，但并非信息论最优（ITO）。另一方面，现有的ITO数据类型（例如分位数/法线浮点量化）并不计算高效。我们提出了BBQ，这是第一个也是计算高效的ITO量化方法。BBQ基于我们的一个关键见解，即由于学习是领域无关的，因此量化器的输出不需要与其输入位于同一域。BBQ在其输入域执行ITO量化，并将其输出返回到一个计算高效的域，其中ITO数据类型被映射到计算高效的数据类型。在不牺牲计算效率的情况下，BBQ通过将4位模型的困惑度降低多达2个点，3位模型降低多达4个点，2位模型降低多达5个点，1位模型降低多达18个点，优于先前最先进的QAPT方法。代码可在https://github.com/1733116199/bbq 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为BBQ（Bell Box Quantization）的新型量化方法，它解决了现有量化感知预训练（QAPT）技术在信息论最优性（ITO）和计算效率之间存在的权衡问题。BBQ利用学习的领域无关性，在输入域执行ITO量化，并将输出映射到计算高效的域。实验结果表明，BBQ在不牺牲计算效率的前提下，在不同位宽的模型上均取得了显著优于现有方法的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 量化感知预训练,信息论最优,计算高效,深度神经网络,边缘设备
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的量化方法BBQ，有效解决了现有QAPT技术的局限性，并在保持计算效率的同时实现了信息论最优性。其将量化输入和输出置于不同域的思路具有独特性，并在多项指标上取得了显著的性能提升，显示了其重要的理论和实践价值。

title: Analysis of Robin-boundary control for the Boussinesq equations
summary: In this paper, we study an optimal boundary control problem for the Boussinesq equations, which couple the time-dependent Navier-Stokes system with a heat equation, where the control enters through a Robin boundary condition on temperature. We begin by establishing the well-posedness of the optimization problem via a variational framework. We then derive both first- and second-order optimality conditions, including explicit characterizations of the adjoint state and the optimal control. Next, we perform a detailed numerical analysis of a fully discrete scheme: using finite elements in space and a semi-implicit scheme in time, combined with variational discretization for the control. We present rigorous a prior error estimates for the state, adjoint state, and control variables. Numerical experiments are provided to validate our theoretical results.

AI.title_translation: 罗宾边界控制对布辛涅斯克方程的分析
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个针对布辛涅斯克方程的最优边界控制问题，其中控制通过温度上的罗宾边界条件引入。研究建立了优化问题的适定性，推导了最优性条件，并进行了详细的数值分析，包括误差估计和数值实验验证。
AI.motivation: 研究最优边界控制问题，特别是针对耦合了Navier-Stokes系统和热方程的Boussinesq方程，并探索通过罗宾边界条件引入控制。
AI.method: 使用变分框架建立优化问题的适定性，推导一阶和二阶最优性条件，包括伴随状态和最优控制的明确表征。采用有限元和半隐式时间离散方法，结合变分离散化进行数值分析，并推导了状态、伴随状态和控制变量的先验误差估计。
AI.result: 建立了优化问题的适定性，推导了最优性条件，并进行了详细的数值分析，包括状态、伴随状态和控制变量的先验误差估计。数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过变分框架、最优性条件推导和详细的数值分析，成功研究了Boussinesq方程的Robin边界控制问题，并验证了理论结果。
AI.translation: 在本论文中，我们研究了Boussinesq方程的最优边界控制问题，该方程将时间相关的Navier-Stokes系统与热方程耦合，其中控制通过温度上的Robin边界条件进入。我们首先通过变分框架建立优化问题的适定性。然后，我们推导出了一阶和二阶最优性条件，包括伴随状态和最优控制的明确表征。接下来，我们对全离散格式进行了详细的数值分析：在空间上使用有限元，在时间上使用半隐式格式，并结合变分离散化来处理控制。我们为状态、伴随状态和控制变量推导了严格的先验误差估计。数值实验被用来验证我们的理论结果。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了Boussinesq方程的最优边界控制问题，该方程结合了Navier-Stokes系统和热方程。控制通过温度的Robin边界条件施加。研究首先利用变分方法证明了优化问题的适定性，接着推导了包含伴随状态和最优控制明确表征的一阶和二阶最优性条件。随后，论文进行了详细的数值分析，采用了有限元空间离散、半隐式时间离散和变分控制离散化方法，并得出了状态、伴随状态和控制变量的先验误差估计。最后，通过数值实验验证了所提出的理论方法。
AI.keywords: Boussinesq方程, 最优边界控制, Robin边界条件, 有限元方法, 误差估计
AI.comments: 这项研究在理论和数值上都对Boussinesq方程的边界控制问题进行了深入探讨，特别是引入了Robin边界条件作为控制手段，这在实际应用中可能具有重要意义。研究的严谨性体现在其对优化问题的适定性证明、最优性条件的推导以及详细的误差分析。然而，论文可能可以进一步讨论该控制方法在具体物理场景中的应用潜力或与其他控制方法的比较。

title: Dehallu3D: Hallucination-Mitigated 3D Generation from Single Image via Cyclic View Consistency Refinement
summary: Large 3D reconstruction models have revolutionized the 3D content generation field, enabling broad applications in virtual reality and gaming. Just like other large models, large 3D reconstruction models suffer from hallucinations as well, introducing structural outliers (e.g., odd holes or protrusions) that deviate from the input data. However, unlike other large models, hallucinations in large 3D reconstruction models remain severely underexplored, leading to malformed 3D-printed objects or insufficient immersion in virtual scenes. Such hallucinations majorly originate from that existing methods reconstruct 3D content from sparsely generated multi-view images which suffer from large viewpoint gaps and discontinuities. To mitigate hallucinations by eliminating the outliers, we propose Dehallu3D for 3D mesh generation. Our key idea is to design a balanced multi-view continuity constraint to enforce smooth transitions across dense intermediate viewpoints, while avoiding over-smoothing that could erase sharp geometric features. Therefore, Dehallu3D employs a plug-and-play optimization module with two key constraints: (i) adjacent consistency to ensure geometric continuity across views, and (ii) adaptive smoothness to retain fine details.We further propose the Outlier Risk Measure (ORM) metric to quantify geometric fidelity in 3D generation from the perspective of outliers. Extensive experiments show that Dehallu3D achieves high-fidelity 3D generation by effectively preserving structural details while removing hallucinated outliers.

title: YCDa: YCbCr Decoupled Attention for Real-time Realistic Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: Human vision exhibits remarkable adaptability in perceiving objects under camouflage. When color cues become unreliable, the visual system instinctively shifts its reliance from chrominance (color) to luminance (brightness and texture), enabling more robust perception in visually confusing environments. Drawing inspiration from this biological mechanism, we propose YCDa, an efficient early-stage feature processing strategy that embeds this "chrominance-luminance decoupling and dynamic attention" principle into modern real-time detectors. Specifically, YCDa separates color and luminance information in the input stage and dynamically allocates attention across channels to amplify discriminative cues while suppressing misleading color noise. The strategy is plug-and-play and can be integrated into existing detectors by simply replacing the first downsampling layer. Extensive experiments on multiple baselines demonstrate that YCDa consistently improves performance with negligible overhead as shown in Fig. Notably, YCDa-YOLO12s achieves a 112% improvement in mAP over the baseline on COD10K-D and sets new state-of-the-art results for real-time camouflaged object detection across COD-D datasets.

title: Sparse View Distractor-Free Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables efficient training and fast novel view synthesis in static environments. To address challenges posed by transient objects, distractor-free 3DGS methods have emerged and shown promising results when dense image captures are available. However, their performance degrades significantly under sparse input conditions. This limitation primarily stems from the reliance on the color residual heuristics to guide the training, which becomes unreliable with limited observations. In this work, we propose a framework to enhance distractor-free 3DGS under sparse-view conditions by incorporating rich prior information. Specifically, we first adopt the geometry foundation model VGGT to estimate camera parameters and generate a dense set of initial 3D points. Then, we harness the attention maps from VGGT for efficient and accurate semantic entity matching. Additionally, we utilize Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to further identify and preserve the large static regions in the scene. We also demonstrate how these priors can be seamlessly integrated into existing distractor-free 3DGS methods. Extensive experiments confirm the effectiveness and robustness of our approach in mitigating transient distractors for sparse-view 3DGS training.

title: What Helps -- and What Hurts: Bidirectional Explanations for Vision Transformers
comments: PAKDD 2026: The 30th Pacific-Asia Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong performance in visual recognition, yet their decision-making remains difficult to interpret. We propose BiCAM, a bidirectional class activation mapping method that captures both supportive (positive) and suppressive (negative) contributions to model predictions. Unlike prior CAM-based approaches that discard negative signals, BiCAM preserves signed attributions to produce more complete and contrastive explanations. BiCAM further introduces a Positive-to-Negative Ratio (PNR) that summarizes attribution balance and enables lightweight detection of adversarial examples without retraining. Across ImageNet, VOC, and COCO, BiCAM improves localization and faithfulness while remaining computationally efficient. It generalizes to multiple ViT variants, including DeiT and Swin. These results suggest the importance of modeling both supportive and suppressive evidence for interpreting transformer-based vision models.
comment: PAKDD 2026: The 30th Pacific-Asia Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining

title: CARE: Towards Clinical Accountability in Multi-Modal Medical Reasoning with an Evidence-Grounded Agentic Framework
summary: Large visual language models (VLMs) have shown strong multi-modal medical reasoning ability, but most operate as end-to-end black boxes, diverging from clinicians' evidence-based, staged workflows and hindering clinical accountability. Complementarily, expert visual grounding models can accurately localize regions of interest (ROIs), providing explicit, reliable evidence that improves both reasoning accuracy and trust. In this paper, we introduce CARE, advancing Clinical Accountability in multi-modal medical Reasoning with an Evidence-grounded agentic framework. Unlike existing approaches that couple grounding and reasoning within a single generalist model, CARE decomposes the task into coordinated sub-modules to reduce shortcut learning and hallucination: a compact VLM proposes relevant medical entities; an expert entity-referring segmentation model produces pixel-level ROI evidence; and a grounded VLM reasons over the full image augmented by ROI hints. The VLMs are optimized with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards to align answers with supporting evidence. Furthermore, a VLM coordinator plans tool invocation and reviews evidence-answer consistency, providing agentic control and final verification. Evaluated on standard medical VQA benchmarks, our CARE-Flow (coordinator-free) improves average accuracy by 10.9% over the same size (10B) state-of-the-art (SOTA). With dynamic planning and answer review, our CARE-Coord yields a further gain, outperforming the heavily pre-trained SOTA by 5.2%. Our experiments demonstrate that an agentic framework that emulates clinical workflows, incorporating decoupled specialized models and explicit evidence, yields more accurate and accountable medical AI.

title: Evaluating and Understanding Scheming Propensity in LLM Agents
summary: As frontier language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents pursuing complex, long-term objectives, there is increased risk of scheming: agents covertly pursuing misaligned goals. Prior work has focused on showing agents are capable of scheming, but their propensity to scheme in realistic scenarios remains underexplored. To understand when agents scheme, we decompose scheming incentives into agent factors and environmental factors. We develop realistic settings allowing us to systematically vary these factors, each with scheming opportunities for agents that pursue instrumentally convergent goals such as self-preservation, resource acquisition, and goal-guarding. We find only minimal instances of scheming despite high environmental incentives, and show this is unlikely due to evaluation awareness. While inserting adversarially-designed prompt snippets that encourage agency and goal-directedness into an agent's system prompt can induce high scheming rates, snippets used in real agent scaffolds rarely do. Surprisingly, in model organisms (Hubinger et al., 2023) built with these snippets, scheming behavior is remarkably brittle: removing a single tool can drop the scheming rate from 59% to 3%, and increasing oversight can raise rather than deter scheming by up to 25%. Our incentive decomposition enables systematic measurement of scheming propensity in settings relevant for deployment, which is necessary as agents are entrusted with increasingly consequential tasks.

title: Predictive Lane-Change and Routing Coordination in Bus-Priority Mixed Traffic Corridors
summary: In this paper, we investigate the coordination of vehicle maneuvers in mixed-traffic corridors where connected and automated vehicles, human-driven vehicles, and buses interact under dedicated bus lane operations. We develop a segment-based network coordination framework that jointly optimizes lane-change and routing decisions of connected and automated vehicles to improve dedicated lane utilization while preserving bus priority. The proposed framework incorporates a predictive bus-protection mechanism that restricts vehicle access to protected lane segments within a monitoring horizon, together with a utility-driven lane-change strategy that accounts for anticipated travel time gains, downstream routing feasibility, and lane-change stability. By explicitly coupling network-level routing decisions with lane-level interaction control, the method proactively mitigates conflicts on dedicated lanes before congestion effects materialize. The proposed approach is evaluated through microscopic traffic simulations in SUMO using a realistic urban corridor. Simulation results demonstrate that the framework enhances bus schedule adherence and reduces average travel times for both automated and human-driven vehicles, while maintaining stable lane-change behavior without increasing maneuver frequency.

title: Coarse-to-Fine Monocular Re-Localization in OpenStreetMap via Semantic Alignment
summary: Monocular re-localization plays a crucial role in enabling intelligent agents to achieve human-like perception. However, traditional methods rely on dense maps, which face scalability limitations and privacy risks. OpenStreetMap (OSM), as a lightweight map that protects privacy, offers semantic and geometric information with global scalability. Nonetheless, there are still challenges in using OSM for localization: the inherent cross-modal discrepancies between natural images and OSM, as well as the high computational cost of global map-based localization. In this paper, we propose a hierarchical search framework with semantic alignment for localization in OSM. First, the semantic awareness capability of DINO-ViT is utilised to deconstruct visual elements to establish semantic relationships with OSM. Second, a coarse-to-fine search paradigm is designed to replace global dense matching, enabling efficient progressive refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly improves both localization accuracy and speed. When trained on a single dataset, the 3° orientation recall of our method even outperforms the 5° recall of state-of-the-art methods.

title: Closing the Gap Between Float and Posit Hardware Efficiency
comments: 25 pages, 16 figures, published in Conference on Next Generation Arithmetic 2025
summary: The b-posit, or bounded posit, is a variation of the posit format designed for high performance computing (HPC) and AI applications. Unlike traditional floating-point formats (floats), posits use variable-length fields for exponent scaling and significand, providing better efficiency for the same bit width. However, this flexibility introduces high worst-case overhead in decode-encode logic, exceeding the cost of handling subnormals for floats. To address this, the b-posit restricts the regime field to a 6-bit limit, reducing variability in regime and fraction sizes. With an exponent size eS of 5 bits, the dynamic range is $2^{-192}$ to $2^{192}$ (about $10^{-58}$ to $10^{58}$) and the quire size is 800 bits, for any precision $n>12$. This constraint improves numerical properties and simplifies hardware implementation by allowing decode-encode operations with basic multiplexers. Our 32-bit b-posit decoder circuits achieve significant improvements: 79 percent less power consumption, 71 percent smaller area, and 60 percent reduced latency compared to standard posit decoders. The 32-bit b-posit encoder shows 68 percent lower power usage, 46 percent less area, and 44 percent shorter delay. The proposed b-posit hardware exhibits superior scalability with increasing bit widths, outperforming standard posit hardware at higher precisions, with even greater advantages at 64-bit. Notably, the b-posit decode-encode hardware matches or exceeds IEEE compliant 32-bit floating-point performance, offering faster and smaller area implementation, with slight increase in worst-case power due to higher speed. The b-posit hardware design provides the clean mathematical behavior and higher accuracy of posits versus IEEE floats without the power, area, or latency costs observed for the Posit Standard (2022). We believe the b-posit should influence future standard revisions.
